notes.title: Small bugfix patch released
notes.content:
Hello!  I just released a small patch for the following bugs:

* fixes an issue where some players would receive damage when transitioning between some rooms
* fixes an issue where some players could cause the game to crash when choosing between dialogue options
* fixes an issue where the player could become trapped in the drainage

Thank you!
